newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi denies it in refinery talks with Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Saudi denies it in refinery talks with Thailand.

text.p: Saudi Aramco has denied reports it was discussing a refinery development deal in southern Thailand with the Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT).
The official Saudi Press Agency said the denial was made on Saturday by an official source at the Saudi Oil Ministry.

"This report is not true and Saudi Aramco has not entered any discussions with Thai authorities in this respect," the source said in reaction to a report on Saturday by the Bangkok Post that PTT was discussing the deal with Aramco.

Aramco is interested in expanding its finished oil products business and is looking for a refinery location from which to target the South Korean and Japanese markets, the paper quoted PTT Governor Pala Sookawesh as saying.
